name: vnite-native
description: Provide native interface for Vnite to interact with Win32 API

scripts.build: napi build --package vnite_native --platform --release -o dist && cargo build --package vnite-process-monitor --bin vnite-process-monitor --release && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('target/release/vnite-process-monitor.exe', 'dist/vnite-process-monitor.exe')"
scripts.build:debug: napi build --package vnite_native --platform -o dist && cargo build --package vnite-process-monitor --bin vnite-process-monitor && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('target/debug/vnite-process-monitor.exe', 'dist/vnite-process-monitor.exe')"
